description:
HushGram v0.0.4 has 46 patches for Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 (arm64-v8a, version code 385511871), eleven more than v0.0.3. It still runs on Android 9 and newer. Every new patch is off until you pick it in Manager.

**Before you sign in,** read the section of that name in the README. A re-signed Instagram can't pass Google's Play Store check whatever the patches do, so a spare account keeps your main one out of it.

## New patches

* `Keep Reels auto scroll on`. Turn on Instagram's auto scroll in Reels once and it stays on after Instagram restarts or you leave Reels. Turn it off and it stays off. Asked for in #21.
* `Keep a seek bar on Reels`. Every ordinary reel keeps Instagram's seek bar, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length just above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Ads keep Instagram's own rules. Asked for in #10.
* `Stop Reels scrolling`. A swipe in Reels doesn't move on to the next reel, and pulling down doesn't load new ones. Instagram's auto scroll still moves on if you've turned it on. A change takes a restart. Asked for in #23.
* `Hide suggested accounts in Reels`. The cards of people and creators to follow that Instagram puts between reels are left out. Asked for in #15 and #20.
* `Hide suggested people on profiles`. Suggested for you and the Discover people button go from profiles, yours and other people's. Asked for in #15 and #20.
* `Hide highlights`. The row of story highlights goes from profiles. Add to highlight on your own stories still works.
* `Loop a story`. A story plays again from the start when it ends, until you tap or swipe. Ads still move on. Asked for in #1, and piko had it first.
* `Show a story's exact time`. A story's header says when it was posted, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of 3h. Asked for in #1, and piko had it first.
* `Stop swipe to create`. A sideways swipe or a quick flick on Home no longer slides the camera in. The + button still opens it.
* `Copy comment`. A selected comment's menu gets a Copy row that copies its text, line breaks and all.
* `Save comment photo`. When a comment carries a photo of its own, its menu gets a Save row that saves the largest size Instagram sent. It hasn't been tried on a phone yet. Asked for in #1.

## Fixes and changes

* View stories anonymously has a second switch, Mark as seen button. It puts an eye in each story's header, and a story you tap it on is sent as seen by itself while the rest stay held back. Views Instagram saved in an earlier session to send later are held back now too. Asked for in #1 and #13.
* The Threads buttons on a profile open Threads when it's patched with the same key as HushGram, instead of showing "Sorry, we weren't able to load that website". Facebook and Messenger patched with that key open the same way. An app that has moved to another key goes back to Instagram's own check. Reported in #22.
* Show if a profile follows you has a second switch, Mark who doesn't follow you back, for your own Following list. Asked for in #1.
* With Tap to play on, Instagram's auto scroll in Reels doesn't stop after one reel anymore. Each reel it moves to plays, and a reel you swipe to still waits for your tap.
* A carousel's feed menu has Save all, which saves up to 32 pages in order with one Cancel for the lot.
* HushGram's settings can be searched by a control's label in your phone's language or by its English patch name.
* Settings backup exports and imports your HushGram choices through Android's file picker, with a 10 second Undo.
* Developer has Open MetaConfig overrides, Export overrides and Validate an overrides file. Allow importing overrides, off to start, lets you put an exported file back and undo it with Restore previous overrides. Asked for in #1.
* When a save stops because Instagram closed, its unfinished files are cleaned up and the next start tells you to save again.
* On a phone set to a right-to-left language, every title and summary in HushGram's settings lines up on the right.
* Default playback quality is in Manager's simple mode. It starts at Auto, so nothing changes until you pick a quality.

## Under the hood

* Most patches check more of Instagram's code before they change anything, so a build that's set up differently is refused instead of misbehaving.
* The translation scripts need Python 3.12 or newer and say so in one line on an older one. Translations can go out and come back as Crowdin-style JSON.
